heading.title: Of False Evidence and Offences Against Public Justice

article.title: Using evidence known to be false
article.content: Whoever corruptly uses or attempts to use as true or genuine evidence any evidence which he knows to be false or fabricated, shall be punished in the same manner as if he gave or fabricated false evidence.
article.html:
233Using evidence known to be false

Section 233 · Chapter XIV

Whoever corruptly uses or attempts to use as true or genuine evidence any evidence which he knows to be false or fabricated, shall be punished in the same manner as if he gave or fabricated false evidence.
